name: Permanent Shelter
placementTarget: On the board, next to a city that had a shelter in the game just played.
summary: No words. A yellow shelter shape inside a dark blue circle. The filename spells the word permenant. The orange 2 next to each icon, and the placement rules, are printed on the Game End Upgrades sheet (sticker-03, P3-29a), not on this icon.

mechanics.timing: Game end, when spending production units. Later games, during setup.
mechanics.effect: Put this sticker next to a city that had a shelter in the game just played. During later setup, add a shelter figure to each city with a Permanent Shelter sticker.
restrictions: Five stickers, so at most five cities can be marked from this sheet.
Only a city that had a shelter in the game just played.
Each icon is marked 2 on the sheet. The words "production units" are on the component list, and the numeral 2 is on sticker-03.
The icon itself has no printed code.
